profile.name: Getachew Haile
profile.title: GIS & Remote Sensing Researcher | Director, ICT Directorate
profile.summary: ICT and geospatial professional with over 15 years of experience at the Oromia Agricultural Research Institute (IQQO), combining executive ICT leadership with applied research in GIS, Remote Sensing, and digital agriculture. Leads institutional ICT strategy, enterprise networking, information systems, and digital transformation, while conducting geospatial and machine-learning research on soil fertility, land suitability, water resources, and climate-agriculture interactions. Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, deliver digital solutions, and support evidence-based decision-making through spatial analysis.

publications.title: Demonstration of pre-determined ECONAT organic liquid fertilizers on tef production in Bora District, East Shewa Zone, Oromia Region, Ethiopia
publications.journalContext: Oromia Agricultural Research Institute Agronomy Proceedings
publications.abstract: Evaluated the agronomic and yield response of tef (Eragrostis tef) to pre-determined applications of ECONAT organic liquid fertilizer against conventional mineral fertilization in semi-arid agro-ecologies. Demonstrates significant yield stability and soil health benefits in moisture-stressed soils.
publications.citation: Haile, G., et al. (2022). Demonstration of pre-determined ECONAT organic liquid fertilizers on tef production in Bora District, East Shewa Zone, Oromia Region, Ethiopia. Oromia Agricultural Research Institute.

publications.title: Land suitability evaluation for agroforestry using geospatial techniques in Genale Sub-basin, Oromia, Ethiopia
publications.journalContext: Applied Geospatial and Natural Resource Sciences
publications.abstract: Developed an integrated GIS and Multi-Criteria Evaluation (MCE) framework to identify optimum agroforestry corridors. Combined slope gradient, soil drainage, rainfall variability, and land cover to support soil conservation and diversified farm livelihoods.

studyRegions.name: Arsi Zone Catchments
studyRegions.researchFocus: Rainwater Harvesting (RWH) Suitability & Spatial Multi-Criteria Analysis
studyRegions.methodology: Integrated AHP pairwise comparisons of slope gradients from SRTM DEM, soil infiltration capacity, and runoff curve numbers to isolate zero-conflict pond and reservoir sites.
studyRegions.findings: Identified over 34 high-potential micro-catchment zones capable of sustaining dry-season supplementary irrigation for smallholders.

studyRegions.name: Genale-Dawa Bale Sub-Basin
studyRegions.methodology: Cross-analyzed satellite optical lineament density, structural faults, lithological permeability, and drainage density with rainfall grids.
studyRegions.findings: Delineated regional aquifers and deep recharge corridors, drastically reducing dry bore-hole rates for water development agencies.

studyRegions.name: Genale Sub-Basin
studyRegions.methodology: Coupled slope stability, soil depth, moisture retention, and land cover dynamics to establish agroforestry zoning.
studyRegions.findings: Mapped optimal agroforestry expansion corridors that protect riparian buffers while multiplying timber and fruit tree yields.

studyRegions.name: Bora District
studyRegions.researchFocus: ECONAT Organic Liquid Fertilizer Demonstration on Tef
studyRegions.methodology: Multi-plot randomized field agronomy trials combined with soil chemistry tests comparing bio-organic spray schedules on tef crop biomass.
studyRegions.findings: Demonstrated superior grain yields and enhanced drought-stress tolerance compared to untreated controls in semi-arid soils.

studyRegions.name: Weyib Sub-Basin
studyRegions.methodology: Applied multi-criteria GIS zoning evaluating temperature isotherms, soil pH, moisture deficits, and accessibility.
studyRegions.findings: Pinpointed climate-resilient zones for multipurpose Moringa plantations to bolster household nutrition and natural erosion control.

studyRegions.name: Adama Zuria District
studyRegions.researchFocus: Land Use Land Cover (LULC) Dynamics & Conservation
studyRegions.methodology: Satellite remote sensing classification over multiple epochs assessing rate of farmland conversion, peri-urban spread, and gulley erosion.
studyRegions.findings: Delivered spatial decision support maps for local agricultural planning offices to enforce conservation corridors.
